reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited §12.3 affirmatively supports it: it records that Customer has made no no-hire commitment and preserves Customer's freedom to hire any person responding to general recruitment, matching the preferred position ('No non-solicit on Customer').
No redline or counterparty comment was proposed, which is the expected output for a compliant finding; the rendered paragraph is unchanged from the original.

The deterministic checks (duration ≤ 12 months, general-solicitation carve-out) are inapplicable here because no non-solicit covenant binds Customer at all — their failure is an artefact of the heuristic, not evidence of a defect.
The only personnel-adjacent restriction noted (§12.4) binds Vendor and benefits our party, so per playbook guidance it is correctly not flagged.
